# The AI Insider Brief

> brief.shiftandlead.com is the Tuesday AI newsletter from Shift & Lead, run
> by Fatiha Chikh, an enterprise operator with 20+ years at Dell, Intel, and
> Microsoft who now runs her own business on 99 AI employees, in public.

This page is a free newsletter for business owners, senior managers, and
professionals who need to understand AI without becoming engineers. Every
Tuesday it filters the week's AI news down to what actually affects a
business, in plain English. Every story on the board carries a verdict:
ACT (do this now), WATCH (track it for later), or IGNORE (skip it without
guilt). Some people know Fatiha as "The AI Automation Queen," a nickname,
not a title.

## Key pages

- This newsletter: https://brief.shiftandlead.com
- Free guide library (guides.shiftandlead.com): https://guides.shiftandlead.com/free-resources.html
- Business site, Fast Forward course: https://www.shiftandlead.com/fast-forward.html

## Usage terms

Content on this page may be cited or quoted with attribution and a link back
to the source page. It may not be used to train, fine-tune, or build machine
learning models of any kind.
